events.title: Demo 0.1.1 update
events.summary: - The forced playstyle trial on first launch is gone; MMO controls by default- A low graphics setting for PCs below minimum specs, especially integrated graphics- The game follows your Steam language, and the wishlist button opens in the Steam overlay (one wishlist each, please)- Fixed some key bindings being lost after a restart- Fixed gamepad players being unable to free the Kkomu- Fixed the rats all running away from their nests when you took a break and came back with Continue- Saves with te

events.title: Greetings from the dev
events.summary: Hello. I'm the developer of Grench Boss.Thank you so much for installing the demo. 🙇This is my first game.I know it still has many rough parts, but I'm learning and getting better little by little.I believe if I keep improving it, someday it will become a pretty good defense game.Any feedback is welcome, in any language you like. Thank you.How to send feedback- Comment on this post- In the game, press F8 to open the report window- Email: contact@induo.works- Discord: https://discord.gg/QZ9BVactG
